LanguageData.DMS_AirportSite.label: remnant airfield
LanguageData.DMS_AirportSite.description: A Legacy remnant drone airfield. The control tower still runs a high-powered decoy radio tuned to the cluster weaver's command band - once the garrison is dealt with, the transmitter can call the mothership down onto the airfield instead of onto your home.
LanguageData.DMS_AirportSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the remnant airfield. A drone garrison holds the tower and the aprons.\n\nThe decoy radio in the tower is intact. Clear the field, then use it to call the cluster weaver down here - far from your colony.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultStationSite.label: vault access station
LanguageData.DMS_VaultStationSite.description: A Legacy remnant surface station built over a buried military storage vault. The freight elevator is locked under an armored cover plate; the station's security console is the only thing that can raise it.
LanguageData.DMS_VaultStationSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the vault access station. A remnant garrison holds the compound.\n\nThe freight elevator is sealed under its cover plate. Hack the security console in the control room to raise it.
LanguageData.DMS_RepairStationSite.label: remnant repair depot
LanguageData.DMS_RepairStationSite.description: A Legacy remnant field maintenance depot. Units too damaged to walk were cradled here for servicing; two of them are still clamped in their cradles behind a sealed door, waiting for a crew that never came back.
LanguageData.DMS_RepairStationSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the remnant repair depot. Automatroids and their drone escorts hold the yard.\n\nThe maintenance bay is sealed. Hack the depot's security console to release the door and reach the cradled units inside.
LanguageData.DMS_OperationBaseSite.label: remnant forward base
LanguageData.DMS_OperationBaseSite.description: A Legacy remnant forward operating base. Razor wire, sandbags and a supply dump on the surface; a freight elevator into a buried store behind two sets of blast doors.
LanguageData.DMS_OperationBaseSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the remnant forward base. A line infantry garrison holds the wire.\n\nThe supply dump is in the open. The freight elevator at the back is behind blast doors that answer to two security consoles; hack both, then hack the lift itself to go down.
LanguageData.DMS_SiteStationSite.label: derelict remnant station
LanguageData.DMS_SiteStationSite.description: A sprawling pre-war station, half of it collapsed, that a Legacy remnant detachment has dug into. Ancient supply crates and wrecked machinery are scattered through the ruins.
LanguageData.DMS_SiteStationSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the derelict station. A remnant detachment is dug in among the ruins.\n\nThe station is large and the garrison is spread out - expect them to converge once the shooting starts.
LanguageData.DMS_LaunchSiteSite.label: abandoned launch site
LanguageData.DMS_LaunchSiteSite.description: A wrecked Legacy missile launch complex. The launchers are gone and the compound is falling apart, but a remnant patrol still sweeps the perimeter, and the wreckage has never been salvaged.
LanguageData.DMS_LaunchSiteSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the abandoned launch site. A remnant patrol is sweeping the wreckage.\n\nThe complex is wide open and full of cover. Deal with the patrol, then strip what the launch crews left behind.
